artworks.title: Base with Reliefs of the Birth of Zeus
artworks.description: Capitoline base: armed dancers clash shields while the infant Zeus is nursed — the Dictaean Curetes drowning Cronus' hearing. Not Homer's Aetolian Curetes tribe.

artworks.title: Rhea Presents the Swaddled Stone to Cronus (relief)
artworks.description: The trick that sends Zeus to Crete: Rhea's stone for Cronus, then the Curetes' din in the cave — nursery and deceit as one succession myth.

artworks.title: Rhea Handing the Swaddled Stone to Cronus
artworks.description: Attic pelike of Rhea's ruse — the moment before the Curetes take up the hidden child in Crete. Metropolitan Museum of Art.
